candidates.summary: TestBareColorRunIsLinear fails under go test -race: the \color[RGB] and \color[{&}] runs of 2^16 take longer than the 2 s convertErrWithin bound
candidates.failure_scenario: A contributor runs go test -race on the mathml package, which the touched-package race rule asks for. TestBareColorRunIsLinear fails in 3 of 3 runs with 'conversion of "\\color[RGB]..." did not terminate'. Under -race the calls take 2.485 s (\color[RGB] x 2^16), 2.315 s (\color[{&}] x 2^16) and 1.979 s (\color x 2^17 + comments), against 560 ms, 396 ms and 512 ms without it. Each run is linear, so the test reports a hang on code that has none. CI's race job runs only TestMathConcurrentRender in ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/, so no job catches it.
candidates.verify_by: go test -race -count=3 -run 'TestBareColorRunIsLinear|TestZZSoloCallTimes' -v ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/mathml/ with tests/solo-finder-race-color-run.go copied in as zz_solo_time_test.go: expect FAIL did not terminate; grep the go test lines of .github/workflows/ci-race.yml

candidates.summary: A cell's trailing comment run is walked once per enclosing style switch, since each switch cuts its cell through sub -> NewTokenBuffer, and that loop finds last from scratch
candidates.failure_scenario: A realm page of 128 $$ blocks of 8 KiB, each \rm x 255 then x then %\n lines, renders in 226-232 ms at head. The same blocks without the switches render in 104-142 ms. Base takes 1.118-1.181 s. Up to 256 nested switches each re-walk the run in NewTokenBuffer (tokenize.go:314), so the comment run is walked about 256 times rather than once. The body's 'every run is walked once' does not hold. Cost is still linear and below base.
candidates.verify_by: go test -count=1 -run 'TestZZSoloSwitch' -v ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/mathml/ with tests/solo-finder-switch-trailing-blanks.go and the base package copied to zzbase: compare trailing=true against trailing=false at switches=255. Then derive the sub's last from a per-formula table shared like cellEnds and re-run: expect the switches page at about the plain page's time
candidates.evidence: 'head switches 128 blocks of 8192 bytes: 226ms' (232ms on rerun), 'head plain 128 blocks of 8191 bytes: 104ms' (142ms), 'base switches ...: 1.118s'. One formula, k=32768 comments: 'head ... switches=255 trailing=true: 15.396ms' vs 'trailing=false: 6.854ms'; 'switches=0 trailing=true: 10.575ms'. k=8192: 3.51ms vs 1.852ms.
